title: VPC observability Terraform module: upgrade orchestration, health probes, and cross-account log-shipper
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a single Terraform module and supporting automation that provisions and upgrades the VPC observability stack (Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and a resilient log-shipper) for Private deployments. The module must: 1) support zero-downtime rolling upgrades with preflight checks and traffic drain hooks, 2) provide cluster-local health probes and centralized canary evaluation against SLOs, 3) support cross-account S3 log shipping with an assumable role and encrypted objects (KMS), 4) include migration helpers for Prometheus TSDB and Grafana dashboards, and 5) expose enough op-config to tune retention, batching, and backpressure for OTLP/log exporters. This ticket covers the Terraform module, upgrade scripts, a canary evaluation runner (lambda/step function), and integration tests that run against a staging VPC cluster.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module can deploy full stack in a staging VPC with a single terraform apply
Module supports a flagged 'canary' upgrade flow: create new release resources, run automated health checks, promote on success
Automated rollback triggers when canary health-checks detect >5% regression on ingestion throughput or >10s tail latency increase
Cross-account S3 log shipping leverages an assumable role and SSE-KMS; IaC includes role policy example for central-logging account
Grafana dashboard migration path: dashboards referenced by uid remain available after upgrade and import script validates panel IDs
Prometheus TSDB retention can be adjusted via module variable and safe upgrade uses snapshot-and-restore approach
All changes exercised by integration test harness in CI; terraform plan/apply are non-destructive by default unless 'promote=true'
Documentation (README) with upgrade runbook, preflight checklist, and known caveats is included in module repo
tasks: Design Terraform module API and variables (inputs/outputs) and publish PR to infra-modules repo
Implement Helm provider-driven deployment for Prometheus, Grafana, and OTEL collector with templated values
Add preflight and postflight Terraform null_resource hooks that run validation scripts against deployed endpoints
Create canary evaluation runner (step function + Lambda) that queries ingestion metrics and runs regression checks
Implement cross-account S3 role and example policy JSON; wire KMS key alias into module outputs
Author migration scripts: prometheus-snapshot.sh and grafana-migrate.sh and include in repo/bin
Write integration tests that bring up stack in staging VPC, push synthetic telemetry, run canary, then promote
Add docs: README, RUNBOOK-UPGRADES.md, and a Troubleshooting section for common failures

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Prometheus TSDB compaction during upgrade can cause backlog and increased memory — Mitigation: snapshot-and-restore strategy + throttled scrape window
Risk: Grafana UID collisions when importing dashboards — Mitigation: import by UID and keep legacy dashboards under a 'legacy/' folder until validated
Risk: Log-shipper overload/backpressure with high log volume — Mitigation: configure adaptive batching and local disk buffering; include SLO thresholds to trigger autoscaling
Risk: Cross-account role misconfiguration leading to data exposure — Mitigation: least-privilege role examples and mandatory security review signoff before promote
